response.sql: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, 1.0 * pc.track_count / ac.avg_count AS ratio FROM playlist_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC, pc.PlaylistId LIMIT 10
